subject: After-hours response variance and supervised escalation plan — Parkwell Finance
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodai.com>
To: Elena Soto <elena.soto@parkwellfinance.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodai.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwoodai.com>
Date: 2026-11-01T14:10:00+01:00
Subject: After-hours response variance and supervised escalation plan — Parkwell Finance

Hi Elena,

Quick note following our engineering heads-up: Parkwell's scheduled data migration the weekend of Nov 14–15 will increase support load overnight in the EU window (UTC+1). We'd like to propose a short-term, supervised variance to your P2 response window for the migration weekend only — aimed at keeping P1 unchanged while giving a 60-minute P2 buffer overnight between 00:00–06:00 CET.

High-level proposal:
- Scope: Parkwell Finance production endpoints only; telemetry enabled for full session traces.
- Duration: Nov 14 00:00 CET — Nov 15 06:00 CET (single maintenance window).
- P1 SLA: unchanged (15-minute response).
- P2 SLA: temporary adjustment from 30 -> 90 minutes (00:00–06:00 CET only).
- Escalation: dedicated on-call shadow, 24/7 pager escalation to Redwood Tier-2, and a nightly bridge point person between 23:30–06:30 CET.

We will provide a runbook, an audit log of all actions, and post-migration incident review within 72 hours. If this is acceptable, I can route a short contract amendment and a DocuSign for signature.

Attached: draft SLA amendment (PDF) and the proposed SLO matrix (XLSX).

Can you confirm whether Parkwell can accept the temporary P2 variance with these controls, or would you prefer an alternative (e.g., increased on-call headcount)?

Thanks,
Jonas
Director, Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference

Attachments:
- SLA_Amendment_Draft.pdf (stub)
- proposed_slo_matrix.xlsx (stub)
From: Elena Soto <elena.soto@parkwellfinance.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodai.com>
Cc: Parkwell Finance Procurement <procurement@parkwellfinance.com>
Date: 2026-11-01T17:03:00+01:00
Subject: Re: After-hours response variance and supervised escalation plan — Parkwell Finance

Jonas,

Thank you — appreciate the heads-up and level of detail. A few immediate asks from our side before agreeing:
- We need explicit audit evidence for all actions taken by Redwood staff during the window (who, what, when).
- Can you confirm that any rollback will happen automatically or that we will be notified with a 30-minute lead time before manual rollbacks?
- Given this touches our payment path, procurement will want a credit schedule tied to any SLA miss during the window.

If you can send a one-page runbook and the amendment we can circulate internally. Also loop in Redwood legal if the amendment needs redlines.

Best,
Elena Soto
Head of Operations
Parkwell Finance
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodai.com>
To: Elena Soto <elena.soto@parkwellfinance.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodai.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwoodai.com>
Date: 2026-11-02T09:15:00+01:00
Subject: Re: After-hours response variance and supervised escalation plan — Parkwell Finance

Hi Elena — quick reply with the operational details you requested. I run support operations and will be point for the migration window. Below is the concise runbook and guarantees we can commit to for the temporary variance:

Runbook (one-page summary):
1) Pre-window validation (T minus 72h): full synthetic checks on payment flows; baseline snapshots stored.
2) Activation (T minus 1h): on-call shadow notified; telemetry sampling increased to full traces for Parkwell namespace.
3) During window (00:00–06:00 CET): P1 handled within 15 mins; P2 target 90 mins only in that overnight window. All actions recorded in the incident journal (user, action, timestamps).
4) Escalation path: Tier-1 -> Tier-2 (support) -> Tier-3 (on-call engineer) -> Ops Lead (Ben Carter) -> Jonas for exec escalation. Pager escalation list attached.
5) Rollback policy: automated rollback script available; manual rollback requires Ops Lead approval. If manual rollback triggered, Parkwell will receive a 30-minute heads-up via email and Slack bridge.
6) Post-window review: 72-hour RCA and raw audit logs will be delivered to Parkwell's S3 share.

Credit schedule proposal (high-level):
- If P1 misses occur: standard SLA credit applies (per contract).
- If P2 misses during this temporary window exceed 5 incidents causing customer-impacting errors, Redwood will issue a one-time credit equal to 10% of the monthly invoice for the affected month.

Attachments: proposed_slo_matrix.xlsx, oncall_routing_flow.png

If Parkwell legal/procurement wants different wording for credits, we can run that through Naomi and Redwood Legal.

Regards,
Ben Carter
Head of Support Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwoodai.com>
To: Elena Soto <elena.soto@parkwellfinance.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodai.com>
Cc: Parkwell Finance Procurement <procurement@parkwellfinance.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodai.com>
Date: 2026-11-02T15:28:00+01:00
Subject: Re: After-hours response variance and supervised escalation plan — Parkwell Finance

Hi Elena,

Looping in legal/procurement support on Redwood's side. We can prepare a brief amendment to the Master Services Agreement outlining: the temporary P2 SLA window adjustment, audit/log delivery terms, rollback notification requirement, and the one-time credit schedule Ben proposed. We will mark the amendment as time-limited to the migration window and revert all SLA terms afterward.

Next steps I propose:
- Naomi to draft amendment (PDF) and send via DocuSign for signature.
- Procurement teams exchange a short SOW amendment if Parkwell requires it.

Ben/Jonas — I'll attach the redline-ready PDF and include a short comment block for procurement to negotiate credits.

Thanks,
Naomi Feldman
VP Legal Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment: SLA_Amendment_Draft.pdf (stub)
From: Elena Soto <elena.soto@parkwellfinance.com>

Cc: Parkwell Finance Procurement <procurement@parkwellfinance.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodai.com>
Date: 2026-11-03T09:45:00+01:00
Subject: Re: After-hours response variance and supervised escalation plan — Parkwell Finance

Naomi, Jonas, Ben —

Thanks for the prompt turnaround. Procurement reviewed Ben's credit proposal and legal is comfortable with the time-limited amendment as long as the audit logs are delivered as raw session traces. We are prepared to sign the amendment contingent on two items:
1) A short kickoff call (30 minutes) to walk through the runbook and oncall contacts — can your team do Nov 10 at 10:00 CET?
2) A confirmed Slack bridge channel and a named nightly bridge contact for the migration window.

If you can send the DocuSign link I'll route to our procurement team.

Approved pending kickoff + bridge.

Best,
Elena Soto
Head of Operations
Parkwell Finance
